page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Two parallel columns of index entries below it, left and right, with marginal references at the end of entries. Below them a distinction heading, further entries in two columns, then a centred index title and the word FINIS, then a printer's ornament (woodcut) in the centre.

main_text.l: Quare præcepit Deus omnibus bona facere & mala vitare, etsi non id ab omnibus vult impleri. ibidem. C
Deus: & mala idem quod Deus. ibid. A
Quòd Dei voluntas per malas hominum voluntates impletur. ibid. B.C
Vtrum placuerit viris sanctis, quòd Christus moreretur, & pateretur. ibid. D
Vtrum passiones sanctorum debeamus velle. tit. E
Quòd homo aliquando bona voluntate aliud vult quàm voluntate Dei.

page.notes: The running head reads "LIB. I." with a stray "I." at the right; the reference "tit. E" is printed as "tit." in the scan and may be "tij." (unclear). The line "Quòd homo aliquando bona / voluntate aliud vult quàm" is cut by the page edge; the second line is read as "voluntate aliud vult quàm" with the end of the line the printed word "quàm" followed by a missing rest, so the final words of that entry are partly illegible in the scan. The ornament at the centre is a woodcut, not text.
